context: A mom and son chat at home
purpose: Teach: 茶碗/はさみ/出掛ける/短冊/さくらんぼ/あゆ/前歯/ヤリ

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、新しい、絶対、お茶碗、絶対、ママ、絶対、用意したわよ
lines.en: Sho, I made sure to get you a brand new rice bowl, just like I promised.
lines.style: Warm, matter-of-fact delivery. Slight lift at the end—the satisfaction of having followed through on something. Bright but grounded, the voice of someone who notices what matters to her kid.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、工作で、絶対、はさみ、絶対、使いたいよ
lines.en: Mom, I really want to use the scissors for my craft project today.
lines.style: Quick, eager opening. Small voice with genuine reaching in it. Trying to sound convincing but mostly just hoping. The earnestness of a six-year-old asking for something he cares about.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 今日、本気で、絶対、お父さんと、絶対、お買い物、絶対、出掛ける、絶対、わね、翔くん
lines.en: Today Dad and I are going shopping, Sho. We'll be out for a bit.
lines.style: Practical, informative tone. Said while doing something else—not abandoning him, just matter-of-factly laying out the day. Warm undercurrent but straightforward.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、七夕の、絶対、短冊、絶対、書いたよ
lines.en: Mom, I wrote my wish on a Tanabata tanzaku strip today.
lines.style: Proud, quiet certainty. The words come out carefully—he's done something and wants her to know he did it right. Small smile in the voice, not loud, but present.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お祖母ちゃんから、本気で、絶対、さくらんぼ、絶対、たくさん、絶対、もらったわよ、翔くん
lines.en: Grandmother sent us so many cherries, Sho. We're lucky she thought of us.
lines.style: Animated, appreciative. Warm lift on the abundance of it. The voice of someone genuinely pleased and wanting him to feel included in that luck. Brightness without forcing it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お父さんが、本気で、絶対、あゆ、絶対、釣ってきたって、ママ
lines.en: Dad actually caught ayu fish today, Mom—he brought them home.
lines.style: Animated, bringing news. Quick pace, the excitement of reporting something interesting. Young voice with the bounce of someone sharing a discovery. Not loud, but alive.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、前歯、絶対、もう、絶対、抜けそう?本気で
lines.en: Sho, is your front tooth getting loose now? Are you about ready to lose it?
lines.style: Tender, genuinely curious. Soft opening. The question carries a little wonder in it—noticing a small milestone. Warm and present, the attention of someone watching him grow.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 運動会で、本気で、絶対、ヤリ、絶対、投げ、絶対、競技、絶対、あったよ、ママ
lines.en: They had a javelin-throw event at the sports day, Mom. I didn't know they did that.
lines.style: Animated report with an undertone of wonder. Bringing information home like a small gift. Young voice, energized, the pleasure of sharing something unexpected he learned.
